goal:
Complete and maintain a source-synchronized Korean translation programme in this strict order: first finish EGA I from the current canonical cursor through the end of the volume; second complete EGA II; third complete FGA. Do not begin SGA in this task. Korean SGA work is certain future work, but its structure and execution will be coordinated separately. Do not let summaries or older broad goals reintroduce SGA, Stacks, Emmy Noether, Lean, or unrelated corpora into this lane.

EGA III is candidate-ready on the user's direct report and is no longer a waiting blocker. It remains sequenced after completion of EGA I, EGA II and FGA and must pass exact project-canonical source-authority packet validation before admission: every page and structural unit present, canonical validation passed, material ambiguities and corrections resolved or explicitly bounded, and no source span missing or provisional. Once those sequence and validation gates pass, admit EGA III without any scheduled, elapsed-time or conversational wait. Thereafter translate only the contiguous ready sequence and stop before the first incomplete later volume. Never fill gaps from OCR, draft English, memory, inference, or another edition.

For every admitted unit, use natural source-bounded units of roughly 4,000 substantive source characters and preserve exact authority and target identities with stable paths, locators, byte counts, and SHA-256. Preserve formulas, labels, references, citations, page markers, notes, hypotheses, quantifiers, map directions, object types, and source corrections. Keep French authority read-only. Correct genuine source defects only in the Korean downstream layer, classify them accurately, and disclose substantive repairs without promoting an inference to an official erratum. Govern terminology by mathematical sense and type, with Hangul-first South Korean register, direct math-particle attachment, stable spacing, and explicit distinctions between similarly named objects.

Completion requires editable Korean TeX in canonical source order, deterministic serial builds with stable late passes and zero critical diagnostics, usable dual extraction, font and ToUnicode integrity where applicable, and proportional rendered-page inspection. Keep source binding, translation and formula fidelity, build, extraction, visual QA, provenance, and publication state separate. Preserve immutable evidence and accepted checkpoints. Rebuild or re-audit only when bytes changed, a concrete defect was found, a required invariant was never covered, or publication readback demands it. Aim hard at perfection in fidelity, mathematical typing, Korean clarity, reproducibility, provenance, and visual legibility, while guarding equally hard against perfectionism: do not reopen sealed correct work for stylistic restlessness, rerun equivalent audits, create pilots instead of completing the corpus, or delay validated progress for an unattainable feeling of certainty.

Maintain one canonical external Korean EGA Zenodo lineage, one additive continuing Figshare article, and the reinstated GitHub repository. Canonical continuity is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21921513; the current exact public checkpoint is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22062866, mirrored byte-identically as https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33314679.v5 within https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33314679 and at GitHub artifact commit c1259d61c3a4b534a83b3039de91454518d33767 with byte-exact evidence head ddd956109a5360cfb1548079ca2556d5a210d944 and final receipt commit d6dcd7a9baa0c91691b23ca69849dd860d76d515 in https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. Zenodo, Figshare and GitHub have passed anonymous public-byte and metadata replay. Never imply that a private working head is public, create a competing lineage or mirror article, or make a blanket rights claim.

The immediate cursor remains EGA I. The task is complete only when EGA I, EGA II and FGA have complete source-synchronized Korean editions satisfying all gates, plus every later EGA volume admitted by the readiness rule. SGA remains out of scope. Durable reentry state is authoritative only in C:/Users/[USERPROFILE]/Documents/interlanguage/03_projects/language_management/cjk/03_working_translations/ag_ko/authority.json, cursor.json, state.json, decisions.jsonl, evidence.jsonl, terms.jsonl, hard.jsonl and HARDENED.md; at each material checkpoint update these exact files with artifact identities, hashes, completed and unresolved work, public status and the next executable action.
